name: Article 2 – § 1 – point 2, after point a; Regulation (EC) No 1223/2009– Article 15 – after point b – 131
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Regulations (EC) No 1272/2008, (EC) No 1223/2009 and (EU) 2019/1009 as regards simplification of certain requirements and procedures for chemical products
part_text: (ba) the following paragraph is inserted: 2a. The assessment of substances under this Article shall explicitly take into account the relevant routes of exposure. Substances classified as hazardous solely for routes of exposure not relevant to the intended use of the cosmetic product shall not be subject to automatic restriction or prohibition.
